versions.content: The LEVEL 0 SPI Handler/Driver shall accept concurrent Spi_SyncTransmit(), if the sequences to be transmitted use different bus and param- eter SPI_SUPPORT_CONCURRENT_SYNC_TRANSMIT is enabled. This feature shall be disabled per default. That means during a Sequence on-going transmission, all requests to transmit another Sequence shall be rejected.
